name: Ranger Steelduster
body:
Among the mech pilots, few are more respected than the steeldusters, scouts and explorers who venture into the dangerous wilds aboard their mechs to fight alien foes and scavenge the wastes for survivors.

Skills

A steelduster gains Fly and Knowledge (engineering) as class skills and loses Handle Animal and Spellcraft.

This alters the ranger’s class skills.

Bonded Mech (Ex)

The steeduster gains a bonded mech*, treating his class level as his pilot level.

This ability replaces wild empathy, spellcasting, and the favored enemy gained at 1st level.

Mech Expertise (Ex)

Starting at 2nd level, whenever the steeduster would gain a combat style feat, he may select feats from the following list in addition to feats he could normally select: Craft Mech*, Craft Technological Arms and Armor*, Extra Mech Enhancement*, Field Mechanic*, Remote Legion*, Remote Piloting*, Salvage Rigger*, Superior Salvage, Technologist*, and Vehicle Expert*.

He does not need to meet the prerequisites for these feats to select them.

Mechanical Scout (Ex)

At 4th level, if the steelduster selects an animal companion for his hunter’s bond class feature, the steelduster may have his animal companion pilot the steelduster’s mech as if the animal companion were proficient with all armor. The mech can always carry the steelduster’s animal companion in addition to its pilot as long as the companion’s size is smaller than the mech’s.

This alters hunter’s bond. This does not make the steelduster incompatible with other archetypes that modify hunter’s bond.
